items.name: about-page
items.title: About page
items.description: The about page template from library items: the bets centered in two tones of paragraph, the team's names, the process statement over numbered rows, and the openings.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of disclosures on black: neutral hairlines between the rows, an ABC Diatype question, a muted answer that opens in place and a chevron that turns. One open at a time, or several.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A question that needs an answer before anything else, on the overlay surface (#141414) over a black scrim: an Agencidev Sans title, one line saying what happens, Cancel and the action (red for what removes something).

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A note or a problem in a #141414 box on black: a Lucide icon, the subject in ABC Diatype, a muted line under it and the button that goes with it. Red for what broke.

items.name: article-card
items.title: Article card
items.description: An article in the list: the cover at 16:10 on the plate fill, the date and reading time in 14px capitals in mid, the title in white and three lines of the excerpt in dim; the whole card is the link.

items.name: article-page
items.title: Article page
items.description: An article template from library items: the way back, the title at the display step, the date and reading time in capitals, the cover at 16:10 and the body in a 36rem reading measure.

items.name: articles-page
items.title: Articles page
items.description: The articles page template from library items: a line in dim, then the articles in a grid of one, two or three columns.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that keeps its shape as it grows: a 1:1 post, a 4:5 story, a 16:9 slide. It draws nothing itself; square corners and a #141414 ground are classes on it.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Who or what something belongs to, in a circle: a picture cropped round, or the name's initials in white ABC Diatype on #141414. Three sizes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for a state or a kind in 12px capitals, square: the quiet fill (the site's chosen filter chip), the plate, a hairline, or a red wash. A small white or mid dot can lead it.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are, in ABC Diatype: each step back a muted link that turns white under the pointer, a small chevron between, the page itself in white.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons that belong together, joined into one block: square corners on the outer corners only and a 1px black seam between them. A field with its button, a button with its menu arrow, or a vertical stack.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The site's button: the plate (#252525) with white 12px capitals and the 4px corner for the one main action, mid with black ink under the pointer; the quiet button, bare dim capitals that turn white, for the rest; a ghost for tools in rows. Sizes and a square icon button.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month to pick a day from: 40px day cells with square corners, the picked day on the plate with a white figure, today in a neutral hairline ring, the months either side faint. Arrows, Home, End and Page Up and Down move; Enter picks.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The brand's card: a #141414 fill on black with square corners, an Agencidev Sans title, a line of ABC Diatype and the body, with actions at the foot. No border, no shadow.

items.name: careers-page
items.title: Careers page
items.description: The careers page template from library items: the page head in two tones and the openings with their department filter.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides in a row on the black ground, 16px apart, one to three in view, with ghost arrow buttons and the place in tabular figures. Native scroll snap: a swipe, a trackpad, the arrows and the arrow keys all move it. It never plays on its own. The track's edges fade while there are slides past them.

items.name: case-study-page
items.title: Case study page
items.description: A case study template from library items: the client's name with its live link, then the work in masonry columns.

items.name: case-wall
items.title: Case wall
items.description: A case study's wall of work: the client's name at the display step with a plate link beside it, then the work in masonry columns 20px apart, square-cornered; a piece in the works is a hairline box with its caption in capitals.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: How a number is drawn: white bars per day under a total, and lines over time in the brand's series order (white, mid (#909090), the subtle grey, dim, then the plate; every other one dashed). Five series at most. Axes from 0 on hairlines (white at 10%); pointing reads a value.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A yes or no that is part of a form: a 16px box in a hairline (white at 20%) on black that fills white with a black check, a bar for a group partly on, and an ABC Diatype label beside it. Form-associated.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Tabs of code: a slat panel (#141414) with a head of tabs (a white line under the chosen one) and a copy button whose label turns to Copied, over code in white with its punctuation and comments muted, scrolling across. Code and the copy button also stand alone.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A part that opens in place and pushes what follows: a quiet ABC Diatype trigger with a muted chevron that turns, and content that grows to its height and settles in.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field-like trigger that opens a list to pick one option from, with a filter over it, on the #141414 overlay panel: the menus' rows, a #141414 fill on the row the arrows or the pointer are on, the pick checked at the end. The list scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A box to type in over a list of actions and places, on the overlay surface (#141414): the field on top over a hairline, groups with a capital label, the menus' rows with an icon and a shortcut. On the page, or in a window opened with Cmd+K. The list scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.

items.name: contact-page
items.title: Contact page
items.description: The contact page template from library items: the two-tone head with a plate button and the email as a quiet one, the ways to get in touch as rows, and notes in dim running copy.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The dropdown menu's rows on the #141414 overlay panel, opened where the pointer right-clicks, or under the focused row with Shift+F10 or the menu key. Arrows, Home, End and Escape are handled; focus returns to what was clicked.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table people filter, sort and page through: a dropdown per filter, heads in capitals that sort, 40px rows on neutral hairlines that take the #141414 fill under the pointer, numbers in tabular figures, Previous and Next under it. It scrolls sideways with fading edges inside the frame.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date in a field: a button drawn as the text field that opens the calendar on the #141414 overlay panel under it. Opening puts focus on the picked day, picking closes it and returns focus, Escape closes it unchanged.

items.name: detail-list
items.title: Detail list
items.description: The contact page's rows: a label in white and its description in dim running copy beside it (a 248px label column from 640), 40px between rows.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window on the overlay surface (#141414) over a black scrim: an Agencidev Sans title, a line under it, a ghost close button, a short form or a partnership, and buttons at the foot.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets the reading direction for what is inside it, so logical spacing and the components follow right-to-left text. Code stays left to right.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge over a black scrim, on the overlay surface (#141414): from the bottom with square corners on its top edge and a grab handle, or from the left or right at full height. The body's edges fade while there is more to scroll.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A button that opens a short list of actions or choices on the overlay surface (#141414): a neutral hairline, square corners, rows that take a #141414 fill under the pointer. Arrows, Home, End, Escape and Tab are handled.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What shows where a list has nothing in it yet: a dashed hairline with square corners, a Lucide icon in a #141414 tile, an Agencidev Sans title, one muted line and the actions that fill it.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label over one control, with a description or an error under it. The label speaks in capitals; the help is muted; an error takes the help's place in red.

items.name: filter-list
items.title: Filter list
items.description: A single-choice filter: the options as 14px capitals in mid, the chosen one white, in a row or a column; color changes only, on pointer down.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields stacked 24px apart, a failure from the server in a dark red box, and the actions at the end, the main one last. Errors wait until a field is left or the form is sent.

items.name: home-page
items.title: Home page
items.description: The home page template from library items: the bar, the rail of work across the first screen, and the statement at its foot with the stat line over it.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: More about a link while the pointer rests on it: the card's #141414 fill, a hairline and square corners. The pointer can cross into it; on touch the link just works.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A field with an icon, a prefix, a unit or a small button inside its hairline, drawn and sized as the input is. The hairline turns white while the field has focus.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code, one cell per character, each cell drawn as the input. It is one real field, so paste and the phone's code suggestion work.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field on black: a hairline (white at 20%) that turns white on focus, ABC Diatype, a mid (#909090) placeholder and square corners. Sizes match the button's.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row: media, a title in ABC Diatype with a muted line under it, and actions at the end. No fill, a hairline box or the card's #141414 fill. ItemGroup puts a hairline between rows.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key: ABC Diatype 12px in the soft neutral, in a 20px box in the quiet fill with a hairline and the small corner. KbdGroup holds the keys of one shortcut.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A field's label: ABC Diatype in capitals, in the soft gray, over the control it names. A muted hint can follow it.

items.name: legal-page
items.title: Legal page
items.description: A legal page template from library items: the title in white and when it changed in mid, then titled rows of dim running copy.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The square, the wordmark and the lockup from the site's own files, white or black only, sized by height.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Menu triggers in a row: a black strip in a hairline with square corners, triggers in ABC Diatype, each opening a panel of rows in the card's #141414 fill. Arrow keys move along the bar and through the rows.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser's own select, drawn as the input: a hairline (white at 20%) on black that turns white on focus, square corners and a muted chevron. Phones open the system picker.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A site's top navigation: triggers and links in ABC Diatype, each trigger opening a panel of links in the card's #141414 fill. It opens under a resting pointer, switches at once between triggers, and opens at once from the keyboard.

items.name: no-signal
items.title: No signal
items.description: The 404 page's no-signal static as a box: a dead channel's charcoal static and grain, with the glitch band rolling up through it and revealing white. It runs at about twenty frames a second and holds still under reduced motion.

items.name: not-found-page
items.title: Not found page
items.description: The not found page: the no-signal static filling the screen, the head centered under the band, a line in dim, and the way home with a white dot and an arrow in a ring.

items.name: openings
items.title: Openings
items.description: The careers page's open roles: the heading in capitals, department chips on the right, and each role a full-width row, the title in white and the department in mid, a quiet fill under the pointer.

items.name: page-head
items.title: Page head
items.description: The page's H1 set like the homepage statement: one size in two tones, the lead in white running on into the rest in mid, centered in a 64rem measure, with a plate and a quiet button under it.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous and Next around the page numbers: 32px ghost buttons that fill under the pointer, the current page in a hairline (white at 20%) box in white. First and last always show, an ellipsis stands for the rest.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel for any content, opened from a button: the card's #141414 fill on black, a hairline and square corners. It grows from its trigger and flips to the side with room.

items.name: process-list
items.title: Process list
items.description: The about page's process: numbered rows, each the number, a title, a white hairline at 10% and the body in mid; four columns from 1024, the body under the title below.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far a task has got: a white bar on a 6px track of white at 20%, with round ends, sliding to each new value on transform. Without a value, a short bar sweeps across at a steady pace.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One of a few, all in view: round marks in a hairline, the picked one edged in white with a white dot. Arrows move the pick.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Two panes and the hairline (white at 20%) between them. The hairline is the handle: it turns white under the pointer, while dragged and when focused, and can carry a small grip. Arrow keys move it too. A pane that overflows scrolls with fading edges.

items.name: row
items.title: Row
items.description: One section of an inner page: 24px in, 40px above and below (56 from 640), a title read by screen readers and shown when asked, an aside under it and the body under that.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A region that scrolls on its own with thin scrollbars: a white at 20% thumb on a clear track. Native scrolling, so wheel, touch and keyboard all work; overscroll stays inside. An edge with more past it fades (fade-y, fade-x, fade-xy) instead of cutting rows off.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a short list, drawn as the field is: a black field, a hairline that turns white while open, a chevron. The list opens in the card's #141414 panel, the chosen row checked. A long list scrolls with fading edges.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The hairline: 1px in the edge (white at 10%), across or down. Agencidev separates with a fill or a hairline, never a shadow.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel at an edge of the screen: the card's #141414 fill with a hairline on its inner edge, an Agencidev Sans title, the body scrolling on its own and buttons at the foot. It slides in on the drawer curve; Escape closes it at once. The body's edges fade while there is more to scroll.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's rail: black with a hairline at its edge, the logo at the top, groups named in capitals, the page you are on on the plate, the account at the foot. It folds to icons with one button. Its body scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: The site's footer: one quiet row, the lockup on the left and every link in a single run on the right in mid, white under the pointer.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: The site's bar: the lockup and the sections in 12px capitals on the left, a quiet link and the plate button on the right; a frosted fade once the page scrolls under it, and a full-screen menu under 640.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of what is loading: a block in the quiet fill with square corners, or a circle, that breathes between full and half opacity. Never a shimmer; still with reduced motion.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value on a range: a 4px white at 20% track, white up to the value, and a white thumb with the small corner. It follows the hand without easing.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The corner where notes from toast() show: the newest in front, two more peeking out above. Pointing at the stack spreads it out and holds their time. A note rises in from below and leaves faster.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Work with no known end: a quarter arc in the color around it, white on black, turning on a white at 20% ring at a constant speed. With reduced motion it breathes instead of turning.

items.name: statement
items.title: Statement
items.description: The homepage statement: a stat line in white with its figure in mid, then one statement at the display step in two tones, the lead in white running on into the rest in mid, left aligned across the page.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On or off, with no words: a hairline track with a gray thumb when off, white with a black thumb when on. The thumb slides on the strong ease-out.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of one kind of thing on black: heads as capital labels in muted ABC Diatype, cells in ABC Diatype 14px, a hairline (white at 20%) between rows and the ghost fill under the pointer. Framed, it sits in a hairline box with square corners. It scrolls sideways with fading edges inside the frame.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one thing, one at a time. The default is a segmented control: a #141414 track, the current view on the plate with a white label. Line tabs sit over a hairline with a 2px white line under the current one.

items.name: team-list
items.title: Team list
items.description: The about page's team: the names in one centered run of 14px white at line height 2 (role and place read beside each); under 640 a list with role and place in dim.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: The homepage's testimonial card: a white plate with the face at the top left, the quote in Agencidev Sans at 20 (16 on phones), and the name and role on one line, the role quieter.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text, drawn as the input is: a hairline (white at 20%) on black that turns white on focus, ABC Diatype, square corners. It grows by hand downward.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: One note, what just happened: the card's #141414 fill, a hairline and square corners, an ABC Diatype title, a muted line, one small plate button when there is something to do, and a close button.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Buttons that stay pressed, side by side on one track with square corners. Each pressed one takes the inset fill with white text. On a narrow screen the track scrolls with fading edges.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: no fill or a hairline at rest, the plate with white text while it is on. Sizes match the button's.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A control's name, for icon buttons: a white fill with black caption text and the small corner. It waits 300ms under the pointer, shows at once on keyboard focus, and the next one in a row shows at once.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The brand's type scale as one part. Agencidev Sans for titles, ABC Diatype for text, Medium for small, labels in regular capitals, the system mono for code. Every variant is a type utility from the tokens.

items.name: work-rail
items.title: Work rail
items.description: The home rail: portrait strips of work in one row, 100 by 280 with 20px between, the first strip a little left of the middle and the row running off the right edge. Square corners; an empty strip is the slat fill.
